basic_details.short_information: District Health and Family Welfare Samiti, Cooch Behar (Office of the Chief Medical Officer of Health, Government of West Bengal) (DH&FW Samiti Cooch Behar) has invited applications for 63 posts in 10 roles under Advt No. DH&FW/COB/6758. The posts include Senior Tuberculosis Laboratory Supervisor (STLS) (NTEP), Senior Treatment Supervisor (STS) (NTEP), Multi Rehabilitation Worker (NPHCE), Staff Nurse (NUHM) and 6 more. The online application is open from 27 November 2026 to 14 December 2026.
basic_details.job_location: South Twenty Four Parganas, West Bengal

application_fee.all_candidates_fee: No Fees of any kind to be deposited

how_to_apply: Apply only online through www.wbhealth.gov.in under E-Governance "Online Recruitment".
Applications are accepted from 27-11-2026 to 14-12-2026 (up to 5 pm).
Incomplete online application is liable to cancellation of candidature.
Bring the online generated application, self-attested, with original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies at document verification.
important_instructions: Experience certificate must clearly show duration, post held, nature of work, employer signature with date, otherwise invalid DGPA/CGPA holders must attach the grade point conversion formula Any omission or suppression of information leads to rejection at any stage Failure to submit any requisite document is liable to cancellation of candidature The Samiti reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage

content_sections.text: Marks for educational qualification (proportionate marking) Marks for experience (where applicable) Computer Test / Interview / Written Test and Computer Skill Test depending on post Document verification STLS and STS: 50 marks - qualification, experience (Govt/Pvt scale) and Computer Test 10 Multi Rehabilitation Worker: 50 marks - qualification, experience and Interview 05 Staff Nurse (NUHM) and CHA (Urban): 100 marks based on percentage in qualifying examination Staff Nurse (HCP) and Community Nurse: 100 marks including Interview 15 BPC (ASHA): weightage for qualification, academic result, experience, Written Test (50 marks) and Computer Skill Test (25 marks)
